overrides.rationale: copy-webpack-plugin 11 declares serialize-javascript 6.x, whose latest compatible release remains affected by a high-severity advisory; the parent-scoped override uses the patched 7.x line without changing unrelated consumers.
overrides.compatibilityProof: Node 24 clean install, Docusaurus development and production builds, site contracts, and browser route tests exercise the copy plugin successfully; npm ls reports the intentional parent-range exception documented in PR #681.
overrides.removalCondition: Remove when the current Docusaurus/copy-webpack-plugin path accepts a patched serialize-javascript release within its declared range, then prove npm ci, dependency audit, site build, and browser contracts without the override.
